addons.name: Alleycat courier
addons.summary: Pick up and deliver fragile packages through Downtown Los Santos traffic against the clock.
addons.description: Random pickup and drop-off points in Downtown Los Santos, marked on the map with a GPS route; you choose your own line through traffic. Packages are fragile: hitting a car, a kerb or a wall, or falling, damages the one you carry, and at 0% it is lost. Heavy packages bring a storm and a headwind that GTBike V sends to your trainer as extra resistance; rain also lowers grip. The clock starts at the first pickup. Not available while a course is loaded; loading one ends the mission.

parameters.label: Packages
parameters.description: How many packages to pick up and deliver.

parameters.label: Time limit
parameters.description: Total time, counted from the first pickup.

parameters.label: Fragility
parameters.description: How much damage a hit does to the package.

parameters.label: Heavy packages
parameters.description: Chance that a package is heavy (storm and headwind while you carry it).

parameters.label: Storm with heavy packages
parameters.description: Thunderstorm in Downtown and rain elsewhere while a heavy package is carried. Rain lowers grip in GTBike V.

parameters.label: Headwind with heavy packages
parameters.description: Wind speed set against the rider while a heavy package is carried; 0 turns it off. GTBike V sends it to the trainer as resistance.

parameters.label: On-screen status
parameters.description: Package, integrity, time and distance as a subtitle in the game.

addons.name: Survival sprint
addons.summary: Pass the target speed and a truck appears behind you. Hold the speed and keep pedalling or it runs you down.
addons.description: For threshold and high-intensity intervals, best on long roads such as the canals or the coast highway. Once you pass the target speed a chaser appears behind you. While you hold the target speed and keep pedalling it keeps its distance, and riding faster opens the gap a little. Below the target speed, for example on a climb, or coasting for longer than the grace time (GTBike V power and cadence near zero, even downhill at speed), it closes in fast. If it reaches you it rams you. Survive the set time to win. Works on a GTBike V course too.

parameters.label: Target speed
parameters.description: Speed that starts the chase and that you must hold.

parameters.label: Start distance
parameters.description: How far behind you the chaser appears.

parameters.label: Closing speed
parameters.description: How much faster than you (or than the target) the chaser drives while you are too slow or coasting.

parameters.label: Coasting allowed
parameters.description: Seconds without pedalling before the chaser closes in.

parameters.label: Pedalling threshold
parameters.description: Power above this counts as pedalling (a cadence of 10 rpm or more also does). Without power or cadence data only the speed rule applies.

parameters.label: Survive for
parameters.description: Length of the chase, counted from when the chaser appears.

parameters.label: Chaser
parameters.description: Vehicle behind you. The Phantom truck is used when the chosen one cannot be loaded.

parameters.label: Ram when caught
parameters.description: The chaser drives into you when it catches you. Off: the run simply ends.

parameters.label: On-screen status
parameters.description: Time, distance bar, speed and a pedalling warning as a subtitle in the game.

addons.name: Ghost segments
addons.summary: Timed segments you mark on the map. Race a see-through ghost of your best attempt and beat your record.
addons.description: Mark segments on the PC window map (right-click: Ghost segment start here, then Ghost segment finish here; the same point twice makes a loop). With this add-on on, riding through a start circle starts the clock and a see-through ghost rider replays your best attempt (or your last one); the screen shows the live gap, green when you are ahead. The finish saves the attempt, and a faster one becomes the new record and the new ghost. Records keep the date, average power and speed. Teleporting cancels an attempt. Works on a GTBike V course too.

parameters.label: Race against
parameters.description: The ghost replays your best attempt or your last one.

parameters.label: Show the ghost rider
parameters.description: Off: only the live gap is shown.

parameters.label: Ghost opacity
parameters.description: How visible the ghost rider is.

parameters.label: Gate size
parameters.description: Radius of the start and finish circles.

parameters.label: Give up after
parameters.description: An attempt longer than this is cancelled.

parameters.label: On-screen status
parameters.description: Segment, time, gap to the ghost and distance to the finish as a subtitle in the game.
